choices.content: Yes, once the table is written, the function is unique
Yes, as long as the points lie on a straight line
Only when it is drawn as a curve can it not be determined

question.prompt: Given only a table of four corresponding points, can a unique function on all real numbers be determined?

solutions.explanation: The table gives only the listed correspondences. Without specifying the domain and all correspondences, the entire function cannot be uniquely determined.
solutions.title: Limits of a finite table
